config_entry_id.name: Config entry ID (Optional)
config_entry_id.description: Use this if you have more than one Firewalla setup. It targets one specific setup.

config_entry_name.description: Use this if you have more than one Firewalla setup and they each have unique names. If names repeat, use Config Entry ID.

pause_rule.name: Pause rule
pause_rule.description: Pause one managed Firewalla rule. Provide either a duration or a resume time. If you provide neither, the rule stays paused until resumed.

rule_target.name: Rule target
rule_target.description: Enter the Rule ID shown on a Firewalla rule switch, or a selected rule ID from the runtime inventory for this Firewalla setup.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Optional. How long to pause the rule, for example 30m, 4h, or 2d 4h 30m.

resume_at.name: Resume at
resume_at.description: Optional. A local date and time when the rule should resume.
